visual_action: A montage of still photos and short video clips from Democratic political rallies. Barack Obama and Joe Biden are shown together on a stage in front of a large crowd and American flags. Subsequent shots show Joe Biden with an unnamed woman; Barack Obama with John Fetterman; Josh Shapiro, Barack Obama, Joe Biden, and John Fetterman on stage together with their hands raised; Kamala Harris waving at a rally with Douglas Emhoff behind her; John Fetterman and Barack Obama posing for a photo; John Fetterman speaking at a podium; and Joe Biden speaking at a podium. The rallies appear to be well-attended.

central_claim: On Election Day, Americans should vote for the Democratic party, represented here by popular and energetic leaders rallying support across the country.
